thread:
ravi: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we landed a few remediation items around GPU capacity/autoscale. Need owners + target dates so we can close the loop. High level: quota requests, scheduler tuning, headroom baseline, runbook updates, recurring-pattern detection.
ava: I can own scheduler tuning. Will run tuning in staging first, then canary to prod. Plan: propose params + perf run. ETA ~3 business days.
sam: I’ll take quota requests + billing sync with cloud. I’ll open the ticket to request reserved headroom and cc finance. ETA ~5 business days.
priya: I’ll update the runbooks and add a short playbook for immediate mitigation (drain + fallback to smaller model). Will also add a short checklist for oncall.
ops-bot: Created tickets: INF-5331 (quota request), INF-5332 (scheduler tuning), INF-5333 (headroom baseline), INF-5334 (runbook update). Links: https://tracker.redwood/INF-5332, https://tracker.redwood/INF-5331
misha: Quick recs from postmortem: bump autoscale min headroom by ~20% for peak windows, reduce scale-down cooldown to 60s, and add a synthetic spike test (5m cadence) to catch slow scalers. Also tag incidents with "recurring-surge" so we can roll up patterns.
ava: Draft scheduler change (staging):
```yaml
# staging HPA override for testing
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: model-server-hpa
spec:
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 30
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 45
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 60
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 10
```
ava: Will run perf compare on staging and post results inline under INF-5332.
sam: Need cost estimate for +20% headroom before I push quota to finance. @priya can you add a quick dashboard card for expected monthly $ delta?
priya: Yep, I’ll add a card to infra-costs dashboard showing baseline vs +20% headroom and token throughput. Will attach to INF-5331.
misha: Also: add an alert rule for sustained queue length > 200 for 2m — that seems to precede most surges. Make it actionable (pager to eng-oncall).
ravi: Summary of owners & IDs: ava -> INF-5332 (scheduler tuning) ETA 3d; sam -> INF-5331 (quota/billing) ETA 5d; priya -> INF-5334 (runbook + dashboard) ETA 2d; misha -> INF-5333 (alerts + synthetic tests) ETA 4d. Weekly check-in recurring Tue 10:00am to sweep progress. If any blockers, call me out early. :thumbsup: 
ava: ack :white_check_mark: 
sam: ack, will ping finance after cost card lands.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Capacity remediation weekly" Tue 10:00am (recurring). Links: https://calendar.redwood/capacity-remediation
deploy-bot: FYI — canary will be gated by INF-5332 and automatic rollback on 5xx > 1% over 5m.
ravi: Thanks everyone — I’ll update the postmortem with owner table and close loop after next check-in.
priya: Leaving notes in the postmortem doc now and attaching runbook PR once ready.
